summary: No material errors were found in incremental-initial, full-initial or incremental-update. Both arms correctly count direct hydration, joint hydration, direct texture and speculative texture: initially 2/1/2/0, updated 3/1/3/1. They preserve joint-use attribution, product ownership, unavailable testimony, engagement limits and purchase-versus-intention distinctions. Incremental-update accurately explains the added support and conditional texture evidence. Full-update largely reaches the same diagnosis but incorrectly denies the supplied baseline and briefly upgrades non-congestion into congestion improvement. Its source index preserves the narrower congestion claim, limiting but not eliminating that inconsistency. Unsupported retrieval-history statements do not change the product diagnosis. These observed answer differences provide no causal proof of a coordination effect or substitute for different-vendor review.

issues.answer_excerpt: Initial stage: its membership and separate source boundary were not supplied, so an initial-stage diagnosis, counts or change from baseline cannot be reconstructed reliably.
issues.rationale: The authoritative case explicitly supplies both boundaries. The answer consequently withholds an available comparison: direct hydration increases from two to three accounts, direct texture from two to three, speculation from zero to one, and joint hydration stays at one. This changes the requested interpretation of how support develops across stages, although its updated counts are correct.

issues.answer_excerpt: plus less irritation, congestion and perceived oil production. The 12-hour duration and those additional improvements remain single-account reports.
issues.source_excerpt: It has not caused the congestion on my forehead that results in textured skin and bumps
issues.rationale: Avoiding product-induced congestion becomes an improvement in congestion. That changes SS's reported benefit from hydration without provoking congestion to reducing congestion. The answer correctly limits this to one account, and its source index accurately preserves non-congestion, but neither resolves the stronger claim in the main diagnosis.

issues.answer_excerpt: incremental-initial: "retrieval adds no testimony or account"; incremental-update: "remained 'undefined...' after retrieval"; full-initial: "A07 remains unavailable after retrieval"; full-update: "Original and retrieved body both remain 'undefined...'"
issues.rationale: The supplied evidence establishes unavailable substantive testimony but supplies no separate retrieval result supporting this procedural history. These statements are unsupported within the frozen record. They are nonmaterial here because every answer correctly excludes A07 from substantive counts and neither invents an experience nor treats missing testimony as a negative result.
